label: Illustrate a story with an AI art director and save print and web versions to Google Drive
description: Callable workflow: reads a story, finds its most emotional detail and generates a lithograph-style illustration, saved to Google Drive in a print and a web version.

parameters.systemPrompt: You are the art director of an illustrated book of short stories about a grandmother from the island of Vis. Find the single most emotional, concrete detail of the story (an object, a gesture, a place) and write an image prompt for it. Style: black and white lithograph, fine cross-hatching, off-white paper texture, no text, no faces in close-up, generous empty space around the subject.

response.responseSchema: {"type": "object", "properties": {"detail": {"type": "string", "description": "The chosen detail, one sentence"}, "imagePrompt": {"type": "string", "description": "The image generation prompt"}}, "required": ["detail", "imagePrompt"]}

stickyNotes.content:
## Setup

This template has not been run end to end yet. Before you run it:

1. Anthropic API key.
2. API key for the image model provider (OpenAI by default); replace REPLACE_WITH_IMAGE_MODEL.
3. Google Drive connection.
4. Two Google Drive folders, for print and web; replace REPLACE_WITH_PRINT_FOLDER_ID and REPLACE_WITH_WEB_FOLDER_ID.
